integrity_statement: Complete direct mathematical proof and standalone exact-integer consistency checker are included; finite checks do not certify infinite quantifiers. Same-model mathematical review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification holds for integers with at most three distinct primes only. Does not settle existence of e-unitary perfect numbers that are not e-perfect at larger support. An unindexed older classification cannot be categorically ruled out.
title: Complete three-prime classification of exponential-unitary perfect integers
